Xbro was good we were slow most of the shift so we just stocked where ever we can. We did have a huge rush where we had 5 pages for about an hour or so straight. We were so busy that I could not get a moment to coach in the moment. I did ask AT if he felt her attitude or demeanor of the rush was affecting the crew. Stock went well as well they were able to get through stock while also being on shift because when we did pick up a little they would hop off and helped us out. We hit a huge rush around 4pm of 5-6 consistent pages. Everyone pushed through and we all tried to keep a positive manner about it and celebrate the little things like if we got one page down. Overall after the rush we stocked up everything and got everything together for the night shift and it was a good shift.

flags.text: Vi!!! She was the best absolutely held it down through our crazy close.

Hazard reported: Yes there was a customer complaint about an experience with one of our employees. She said she came through and the employee had not pulled the car up and was talking for awhile with the custie. The customer then went around the person in line to the window to then ask for a paper clip. The runner apparently ran inside and told her we did not have any paper clips and could not give them to her, even though the person on window just left to go grab one. Customer stated that this happened before 4:30pm and said that the runner was short and blonde wearing pink. I gave her a free coffee in us and passed her complaint on to the managers. Later in the evening as I am solo doing a trash run on my third trip there is a homeless lady standing in the shadows of our trash area. She then left once I showed up but she was standing next to me as I closed up the trash area. This leads me to worry about us not having locks and wondering if she might come back now that she knows. Later on the police showed up for some coffee so I asked them to check it out and they confirmed no one else was in there at that time.

Niki was not finished shutting down bar by 7:20pm and so I sent her home and finished it ourselves. I also was unable to find any of the cleaning tablets to flush the heads by 11:20 and so we just cleaned them to the best of our abilities.
